55021-through-swamp-and-glade-a-tale-of-.creator: Unknown
55021-through-swamp-and-glade-a-tale-of-.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The scene is laid in Florida, that beautiful land of the far south, in which Ponce de Leon located the fabled Spring of Eternal Youth. It is a land of song and story, of poetry and romance; but one also of bitter memories and shameful deeds.

arxiv-2104-13912.title: On the construction of almost general solutions for PDEs arising in nonlinear optics
arxiv-2104-13912.creator: A Ghose-Choudhury, Sudip Garai
arxiv-2104-13912.description: Abstract In this communication we consider the widely used nonlinear Fokas-Lenells equation, the cubic focussing nonlinear Schrödinger equation in (2+1)-dimensions and the coupled Drinfel’d-Sokolov-Wilson equation and attempt to construct almost general solutions for the envelope of the wave packet by means of the travelling wave ansatz.

arxiv-2105-05550.title: Generalised regularisation maps on partitions
arxiv-2105-05550.creator: Diego Millan Berdasco
arxiv-2105-05550.description: Abstract In a 1976 landmark paper, Gordon James defined the regularisation maps on integer partition, yielding certain decomposition numbers for modular representations of 𝔖 n \mathfrak{S}_{n} . We describe a generalisation of James’s regularisation map and give with proof an algorithm for such maps in the abacus.

arxiv-2109-14039.title: Marked Attribute Bias in Natural Language Inference
arxiv-2109-14039.creator: Hillary Dawkins
arxiv-2109-14039.description: Abstract Reporting and providing test sets for harmful bias in NLP applications is essential for building a robust understanding of the current problem. We present a new observation of gender bias in a downstream NLP application: marked attribute bias in natural language inference.

arxiv-2212-08305.title: Ghost in the Shell: Evidence for Past AGN Activities in NGC 5195 from a Newly Discovered large-scale Ionized Structure Facilities: CFHT (SITELLE), CXO (ACIS), LOFAR astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ) , CIAO ( Fruscione et al. 2006 ) , DS9 ( Joye & Mande
arxiv-2212-08305.creator: Xiaoyu Xu (许啸宇), Junfeng Wang
arxiv-2212-08305.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Xiaoyu Xu (许啸宇), Junfeng Wang. The early-type galaxy NGC 5195 (alternatively known as M51b) possesses extended gas features detected in multi-wavelength, postulated to be associated with previous activities of the central supermassive black hole (SMBH).

arxiv-2304-10946.title: CancerGPT: Few-shot Drug Pair Synergy Prediction using Large Pre-trained Language Models
arxiv-2304-10946.creator: Tianhao Li*, Sandesh Shetty*, Advaith Kamath, Ajay Jaiswal, Xiaoqian Jiang, Ying Ding, Yejin Kim
arxiv-2304-10946.description: Abstract Large pre-trained language models (LLMs) have been shown to have significant potential in few-shot learning across various fields, even with minimal training data. However, their ability to generalize to unseen tasks in more complex fields, such as biology, has yet to be fully evaluated.

arxiv-2306-05829.title: A reduced-rank approach to predicting multiple binary responses through machine learning
arxiv-2306-05829.creator: The Tien Mai
arxiv-2306-05829.description: Abstract This paper investigates the problem of simultaneously predicting multiple binary responses by utilizing a shared set of covariates. Our approach incorporates machine learning techniques for binary classification, without making assumptions about the underlying observations. Instead, our focus lies on a group of predictors, aiming to identify the one that minimizes prediction error.

arxiv-2403-11611.title: A splitting-based KPIK method for eddy current optimal control problems in an all-at-once approach Thanks: The work is supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China (Grant Nos. 12126344, 12126337 and 11901324) and the China Scholarship Council (No. 202308350044).
arxiv-2403-11611.creator: Min-Li Zeng 1,2,∗, Martin Stoll 2
arxiv-2403-11611.description: Abstract In this paper, we focus on efficient methods to fast solve discretized linear systems obtained from eddy current optimal control problems in an all-at-once approach. We construct a new low-rank matrix equation method based on a special splitting of the coefficient matrix and the Krylov-plus-inverted-Krylov (KPIK) algorithm. Firstly, we rewrite the resulting discretized linear system in a matrix-equation form.

arxiv-2405-02899.title: Superposition of CP-Even and CP-Odd Higgs Resonances: Explaining the 95 GeV Excesses within a Two-Higgs Doublet Model
arxiv-2405-02899.creator: Rachid Benbrik a, Mohammed Boukidi a, Stefano Moretti b,c
arxiv-2405-02899.description: Abstract We propose an explanation for the observed excesses around 95 GeV in the di-photon and di-tau invariant mass distributions, as reported by the CMS collaboration at the Large Hadron Collider (LHC). These findings are complemented by a long-standing discrepancy in the b ​ b ¯ b\bar{b} invariant mass at the Large Electron-Positron (LEP) Collider.

arxiv-2406-08238.title: Residual Learning and Context Encoding for Adaptive Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2406-08238.creator: Mohammadreza Nakhaei 1, Aidan Scannell 1,2, Joni Pajarinen 1
arxiv-2406-08238.description: Abstract Offline reinforcement learning (RL) allows learning sequential behavior from fixed datasets. Since offline datasets do not cover all possible situations, many methods collect additional data during online fine-tuning to improve performance. In general, these methods assume that the transition dynamics remain the same during both the offline and online phases of training.

arxiv-2502-01922.title: LAST SToP For Modeling Asynchronous Time Series
arxiv-2502-01922.creator: Shubham Gupta, Thibaut Durand, Graham Taylor, Lilian W. Białokozowicz
arxiv-2502-01922.description: Abstract We present a novel prompt design for Large Language Models (LLMs) tailored to Asynchronous Time Series . Unlike regular time series, which assume values at evenly spaced time points, asynchronous time series consist of timestamped events occurring at irregular intervals, each described in natural language.

arxiv-2511-12874.title: Classification of Hope in Textual Data using Transformer-Based Models
arxiv-2511-12874.creator: Chukwuebuka Fortunate Ijezue, Fredrick Eneye Tania-Amanda Nkoyo, Maaz Amjad
arxiv-2511-12874.description: Abstract This paper presents a transformer-based approach for classifying hope expressions in text. We developed and compared three architectures (BERT, GPT-2, and DeBERTa) for both binary classification (“Hope” vs. “Not Hope”) and multiclass categorization (five hope-related categories). Our initial BERT implementation achieved 83.65% binary and 74.87% multiclass accuracy. In the extended comparison, BERT demonstrated superior performance (84.49% binary, 72.

arxiv-2602-07358.title: UTOPIA: Unlearnable Tabular Data via Decoupled Shortcut Embedding
arxiv-2602-07358.creator: Jiaming He, Fuming Luo, Hongwei Li, Wenbo Jiang, Wenshu Fan, Zhenbo Shi, Xudong Jiang, Yi Yu
arxiv-2602-07358.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Jiaming He, Fuming Luo, Hongwei Li, Wenbo Jiang, Wenshu Fan, Zhenbo Shi, Xudong Jiang, Yi Yu. Unlearnable examples (UE) have emerged as a practical mechanism to prevent unauthorized model training on private vision data, while extending this protection to tabular data is non-trivial. Tabular data in finance and healthcare is highly sensitive, yet existing UE methods transfer poorly because tabular features mix numerical and categorical constraints and exhibit saliency sparsity, with learning dominated by a few dimensions.

pmc-10562323.creator: Erfan Ghanad, Cui Yang, Christel Weiß, Mario Goncalves, Maria Joao Santos, Nuno Correia, Christoph Reissfelder, Henry Johannes Greten, Florian Herrle
pmc-10562323.description: BackgroundOptimal pain management is one of the core elements of Enhanced Recovery After Surgery (ERAS®) protocols and remains a challenge. Acupuncture (AC) is an effective treatment for various pain conditions. Systematic and personalized allocation of acupoints may be decisive for efficacy.

pmc-10599008.title: Mass spectrometry quantifies target engagement for a KRASG12C inhibitor in FFPE tumor tissue
pmc-10599008.creator: Andrew G Chambers, David C Chain, Steve M Sweet, Zifeng Song, Philip L Martin, Matthew J Ellis, Claire Rooney, Yeoun Jin Kim
pmc-10599008.description: BackgroundQuantification of drug-target binding is critical for confirming that drugs reach their intended protein targets, understanding the mechanism of action, and interpreting dose-response relationships. For covalent inhibitors, target engagement can be inferred by free target levels before and after treatment.

pmc-11416663.title: Left Ventricular Wall Stress and Incident Heart Failure in Elderly Community-Dwelling Individuals
pmc-11416663.creator: Audrey White, Debra D Dixon, Vineet Agrawal, Evan Brittain, Brian Lindman, Ravinder Mallugari, Jonathan D Mosley, Andrew S Perry, Ravi V Shah, Quinn S Wells, Allison L Kuipers, Deepak K Gupta
pmc-11416663.description: BackgroundGreater left ventricular (LV) wall stress is associated with adverse outcomes among patients with prevalent heart failure (HF). Less is known about the association between LV wall stress and incident HF.ObjectivesThe purpose of the study was to identify clinical factors associated with wall stress and test the association between wall stress and incident HF.

pmc-11531933.title: Disordered eating and cardiometabolic risk factors in Chinese women: evidence from the China Health and Nutrition Survey
pmc-11531933.creator: Baiyu Qi, Gabrielle E Cooper, Laura M Thornton, Ruyue Zhang, Shuyang Yao, Annie Green Howard, Penny Gordon-Larsen, Shufa Du, Huijun Wang, Bing Zhang, Cynthia M Bulik, Kari E North, Melissa A Munn-Chernoff
pmc-11531933.description: Disordered eating (DE) is associated with elevated cardiometabolic risk (CMR) factors, yet little is known about this association in non-Western countries. We examined the association between DE characteristics and CMR and tested the potential mediating role of BMI. This cross-sectional study included 2005 Chinese women (aged 18–50 years) from the 2015 China Health and Nutrition Survey.

pmc-11629872.title: Exploring the efficacy of Cystoseira sedoide alga for cadmium and copper biosorption: an integrated experimental and computational study†
pmc-11629872.creator: Nadjette Bengourna, Karima Belguidoum, Dounya Khalla, Mouna Nacef, Imane Kouadri, Aida Benhamida, Habiba Amira-Guebailia, Alaa eddine Brouk, Abed Mohamed Affoune, Hamid Satha
pmc-11629872.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Pollution by heavy metals is a major global issue. The biosorptive removal of Cd2+ and Cu2+ by Cystoseira sedoide (C. sedoide) was evaluated in this work. FTIR and XRD analysis were performed to determine the characteristics of the biosorbent. In batch biosorption studies, several operating parameters such as solution pH and concentration, contact time, biosorbent dose and temperature were tested and optimized for the effective elimination of cadmium and copper ions. Results were further compared to industrial activated carbon (Ac.C).

pmc-12651771.title: A Cascaded RPA-SDA Amplification Strategy on a Sliding Microfluidic Chip for the Ultrasensitive and Rapid Detection of Shigella
pmc-12651771.creator: Nali Zhou, Guorong Fan, Nan Yang, Tao Xu, Yunlong Zhang, Wentao Xu, Ying Shang, Antonio Bevilacqua
pmc-12651771.description: In this study, a sliding microfluidic biosensor integrating RPA-SDA cascaded amplification was developed for the rapid, visual detection of Shigella. A novel RPA primer targeting the specific ipaH gene was designed to include a 5′-end G-quadruplex (G4) sequence and the complementary sequence of an Nt.BstNBI endonuclease recognition site.

pmc-12949623.title: Prediction of SCA Scores in Specialty Coffee Using Machine Learning
pmc-12949623.creator: Gabriel Rezende Ferraz, Felipe André Oliveira Freitas, Harim H Baldi, Natally Ferreira Lima, Gabriela Maria Rodrigues
pmc-12949623.description: Coffee is a major global commodity, with specialty coffees valued for their quality, assessed through standardized sensory protocols. The SCA (Specialty Coffee Association) score is a key indicator of commercial value, but sensory evaluation is resource‐intensive and subject to variability.

pmc-13078049.title: The influencing factors of amplitude-integrated electroencephalography and bilirubin-induced neurological dysfunction scores in neonates with hyperbilirubinemia: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13078049.creator: Jie Chen, Linglin Xia, Jiaojiao Wu, Wenjie Dai, Yitong Zhang, Kerong Li, Yan Ma
pmc-13078049.description: BackgroundAmplitude-integrated electroencephalography (aEEG) and bilirubin-induced neurological dysfunction (BIND) scores are important bedside tools for evaluating neonatal brain function, particularly regarding bilirubin-induced brain injury. This study aimed to analyze the influencing factors of aEEG and BIND scores in neonates with hyperbilirubinemia.MethodsA total of 294 neonates with gestational ages of ≥ 35 weeks, diagnosed with hyperbilirubinemia were enrolled.

pmc-13087252.title: A CXCR4 targeting peptide delivered by silica nanoparticles eliminates migrating cancer stem cells in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
pmc-13087252.creator: Kanishka Tiwary, Anton Lahusen, Syeda Inaas, Bastian Beitzinger, Roman Schmid, Mirja Harms, Stefanie Hauff, Frank Arnold, Karolin Walter, Sonia Alcala, Stephan Hahn, Elisabeth Heßmann, Alexander Kleger, Ninel Azoitei, Thomas Seufferlein, Bruno Sainz, Jan Münch, Mika Lindén, Patrick C Hermann
pmc-13087252.description: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is among the most aggressive and metastatic malignancies worldwide. Migrating cancer stem cells (miCSCs), marked by CD133⁺CXCR4⁺ expression is a key driver of PDAC progression, which currently lack effective therapeutic targets. Activated pancreatic stellate cells (PSCs) within the tumor microenvironment secrete CXCL12, the ligand for CXCR4, thereby promoting stemness, epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT), and chemoresistance in miCSCs.

pmc-13197719.title: Transient abnormal acylcarnitine profile in newborn screening mimicking multiple acyl-Coenzyme A dehydrogenase deficiency associated with maternal sertraline use
pmc-13197719.creator: Rebecca Barbetti, Kate Coleman, Louise Fraser, Kalliope Demetriou, Elaine Jayadiwangsa, Drago Bratkovic, Carol Wai-Kwan Siu
pmc-13197719.description: BackgroundMultiple acyl-Coenzyme A dehydrogenase deficiency (MADD) is an inborn error of metabolism affecting fatty acid, amino acid and choline oxidation and is included in newborn screening in Australia. Recent reports describe adults with clinical and biochemical features of MADD, but negative genetic findings, associated with sertraline use.

pmc-13251781.title: Trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) in HER2-expressing gynecological malignancies: Clinical evidence, safety profile, and future directions
pmc-13251781.creator: Heena Arshad, Inamullah Arshad, Hamza Massab Rehman, Safia Bibi, Muhammad Hassaan Javaid, Ruben Simon Roy
pmc-13251781.description: Highlights•Trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) shows the highest response rates in HER2 IHC 3 + tumors.•DESTINY-PanTumor02 supports tumor-agnostic HER2 targeting.•Interstitial lung disease is a major adverse effect that requires early detection.•Precise HER2 assessment is crucial for patient selection.•Ongoing research may support the use of T-DXd in earlier lines of therapy.

pmc-13291464.title: Pain-Related Impairment and Talar Tilt as Predictors of Surgical Decision Making in Advanced Varus Ankle Osteoarthritis
pmc-13291464.creator: Hiroaki Kurokawa, Akira Taniguchi, Chika Nakaniwa, Norihiro Tsujimoto, Yoshiyuki Kamatani, Yinghao Li, Nan Mei, Takuma Miyamoto, Yasuhito Tanaka, Kenji Kawamura
pmc-13291464.description: Background:Varus-type ankle osteoarthritis (OA) is often managed conservatively; however, surgical intervention is required in some patients. Identifying factors associated with transition to surgery may help optimize treatment timing.Methods:This retrospective study included 53 ankles in 45 patients with Takakura-Tanaka stage ≥3a varus ankle OA who newly initiated conservative treatment with lateral wedge insoles.

pmc-13388366.title: Towards an integrative structural model of the fishnet slit diaphragm: Understanding its physiology through proteomics and structural insight
pmc-13388366.creator: Achilleas S. Frangakis, Alexandra N. Birtasu, Florian Grahammer
pmc-13388366.description: The kidney slit diaphragm (SD) connects the foot processes of glomerular podocytes, anatomically forming the outermost part of the three-layered glomerular filtration barrier. The SD is a large molecular polymer that, together with the foot processes, covers the glomerular capillaries and has diverse functions.

pmc-13422561.title: Implementing a federated regional diabetes register in a decentralized health system: implications for healthcare organization and the European Health Data Space
pmc-13422561.creator: Fabrizio Carinci, Rossella Messina, Martina Mencarelli, Massimo M. Michelini, Amelia Bici, Arianna Berardo, Alessandra Dei Cas, Elisa Iezzi, Raffaella Aldigeri, Concetta Tania Di Iorio, Stefano Gualdi, Maria Pia Fantini, Riccardo Bonadonna, Nicholas Nicholson, Massimo Massi Benedetti, Paolo Di Barto
pmc-13422561.description: BackgroundFragmentation of health information systems remains a major barrier to effective health system performance across Europe, particularly in decentralized settings. Federated data infrastructures have been proposed as a scalable solution, but evidence on their implementation at population level remains limited.

pmc-13424857.title: The generalist’s context advantage: why family physicians may be uniquely positioned for artificial intelligence-augmented clinical practice
pmc-13424857.creator: Sang Hyun Ahn

pmc-13607940.title: Experimental Releases of Pupal Parasitoids to Control Piophila casei (L.) (Diptera: Piophilidae) in Ham Production
pmc-13607940.creator: Diletta Missere, Riccardo Girodo, Antonio Martini, Niccolò Patelli, Giovanni Burgio
pmc-13607940.description: Simple SummaryThe protection of stored foods from insect pests is an increasing challenge, especially as the use of chemical insecticides becomes more restricted for environmental and health reasons. Dry-cured ham, a traditional and high-value product, can be attacked by Piophila casei (L.) whose larvae feed on the meat, causing serious economic losses and food safety concerns.

pmc-13633961.title: Different irrigation solutions in calcium hydroxide removal: Do high-frequency ultrasonic and laser activation make the difference?
pmc-13633961.creator: Ayşe Tuğba Eminsoy Avcı, İpek Eraslan Akyüz, Hüseyin Sinan Topçuoğlu
pmc-13633961.description: This study aimed to comparatively evaluate the effectiveness of different irrigation solutions and activation techniques in removing calcium hydroxide (CH) from standardized artificial grooves located in the apical third of root canals. Ninety extracted single-rooted human maxillary central incisors were instrumented using a standardized preparation protocol.
